name: quickgui
use_label: Native GUI for Go, TS and Rust
one_liner: Renders desktop interfaces on the GPU without a webview.

text.why: Wrapping a desktop app in a webview is easy to build and heavy to run. quickgui is an experiment in the other direction: a GUI framework that renders on the GPU with no webview at all. It is written in Rust and has its own homepage. The repository calls itself experimental (the README states MIT OR Apache-2.0), so for now it is closer to something to look at than to build on.
text.take: The repo itself says not to use it for anything serious; for now it is something to watch, not build on.
build: A desktop interface prototype running without a webview
A performance comparison between rendering approaches

who.situation: keeps an eye on GUI frameworks without a webview
wants a native window from the language they use

start.text: Needs Bun 1.4+ (Go 1.23+ for Go apps, a Rust toolchain for Rust, Xcode CLT on macOS)

caveat: The README says it is very experimental and not for anything serious
Polish is macOS-first; Windows and Linux compile but are still rough
GitHub metadata shows no license, but the README states MIT OR Apache-2.0

numbers.method: Star total = the value last checked on GitHub (stars_checked_at) + increases observed via GH Archive since. The 24h · 7d · 30d gains are GH Archive hourly events summed to the reference time (as_of). No score of ours.
